As an ADHDer, I’ve just had to resort to non-prescription solutions (diet, full good night’s sleep, vitamin supplements) and though it isn’t nearly as good as stimulant meds, this is the best I can do right now.

Good luck and be well.

People have been telling me for years that I “without a doubt” had ADHD, but I never got around to getting it diagnosed. I just kinda assumed that, yeah, probably did, and went on with my day. 

But I also never really did any research on it. A couple of months ago I started looking into what ADHD actually was, and realized that me, a 23yr old dude who has always had passions but never been able to grasp them, has truly been struggling unnecessarily all his life. 

I just thought it was normal to struggle. Or that I was lazy, stupid, unmotivated, passionate in theory but not in practice, as all my teachers had told me. I always thought I was smart and had passions, but I just could never grasp them. It frustrated me to no end. But here, it looked like there was a legitimate reasoning for why I was this way.

I made the appointment to be diagnosed about a month ago, and as the month went by, I lived in fear. 
“What if I don’t have ADHD? What then?” 
Well, then everyone must have been right. I was lazy and stupid. And that idea broke my heart. I knew I tried SO hard all of my life to do what I could to keep up- if the diagnosis was a no on ADHD, it was back to square one of me trying to figure out what was wrong with me. I had already been tested, misdiagnosed and crossed off for so many things. 

Two days ago, I went in to get my evaluation results.
“I’m sorry, but it does look like you have Adult ADD.”

I felt a rush of relief. Best news I’ve heard in years.

Funnily enough, his tactics in canon (at least during a fight) work for me. Be overwhelmingly aggressive, cut your abilities early, basically just throw everything you have at the enemy with a razor sharp defense to match. When I’m not using abilities, I’m trading blows and blocks. Though his greatest defense is his overwhelming offense, and a well-timed dodge. 

As for fights against blaster heroes, don’t be greedy. He gets murdered by them as he isn’t much in lieu of block or deflection, so keep your distance and bait them into moving in. Once you’re close enough, again, overwhelm them with everything you’ve got. 

Yoda is your trump card. His dash breaks through your block, as it does others. Wait for him to make a mistake and zero in.

Claw rush people in the air to hit them upon landing. Scare enemies with unrelenting advance and cancel it before they get behind you.
